I’m a Data Scientist & AI Engineer with a Master’s degree in Data
Science and a Bachelor’s in Applied Mathematics. 
I have hands-on experience in machine learning, LLMs, NLP, and
real-time AI applications. I’ve built ETL pipelines using Airflow,
PySpark, and BigQuery, and developed AI tools with FastAPI,
Flask, and Streamlit. My work includes chatbot development, time-
series forecasting, and image classification. I’m also skilled in data
visualization using Tableau, Power BI, and Excel. 
I’m passionate about using AI and big data to solve real business
problems.
